items.quote: 9:8 And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying, 9:9 And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you; 9:10 And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
items.claim: The text (Genesis 9:8-10) says God spoke to Noah and his sons and made a covenant with them, their descendants, and every living creature that came out of the ark (birds, cattle and every beast of the earth). This is what the text says happened. It is not independent historical proof that it did.
items.object: Noah, his sons, their seed, and every living creature that went out of the ark
